subject: nereid-immutable-core
q: Age Stability says twenty-eight became a Found Family tradition because VIRAENA AND SELENE PRESERVED THE AGE AT WHICH THEY MARRIED, EIGHT CENTURIES AGO. Selene is 863. The arithmetic leaves about sixty-three years before the wedding.
detail:
ANSWERED, AND THE FIRST BRANCH WAS THE RIGHT ONE. EIGHT CENTURIES IS LOOSE. Viraena’s words: it ROLLS OFF THE TONGUE BETTER, and TECHNICALLY WE WOULD BE MUCH OLDER IF YOU DID NOT JUMP US FORWARD IN TIME.

AND THE ANSWER CAME WITH AN ORIGIN THE ARCHIVE DID NOT HAVE: THEY COME FROM THE TWELFTH CENTURY BC. Which makes eight centuries not an approximation of eight hundred and thirty-five years but a ROUNDED-DOWN FIGURE FOR SOMETHING OVER THREE THOUSAND. The recorded 863 is the preserved-prime arithmetic, not the span of the marriage.

THE MECHANISM IS SELENE’S. She jumps them forward in time when she is left to stew in the horny for a few days — WHICH IS WHY SHE GETS VIRAENA THREE TIMES A DAY. So the drift in the number is not bookkeeping error. IT IS A FOXWIFE’S IMPATIENCE, COMPOUNDED OVER THIRTY-TWO CENTURIES.

WHAT STANDS UNCHANGED AND MATTERS MORE THAN THE ARITHMETIC: THE WHOLE FAMILY’S TRADITION OF CHOOSING TWENTY-EIGHT COMES FROM THESE TWO, and it is not the Clinic standard.
